Handheld all-in-one flight controller (thumbstick with center press, multifunction wheel, twin sliders, five-way hat, five-button D-pad, six-pack, bumpers, triggers). Button numbers 1-17 from the 'BUTTON ID' diagram of Yawman's Microsoft Flight Simulator key assignment sheet (hosted by Sporty's): 1 = thumbstick press, 2-4 / 5-7 = six-pack top / bottom row (1L-1R / 2L-2R), 8 = five-way hat press, 9 / 11 = top right / top left edge, 10 = D-pad center, 14 / 15 / 16 / 17 = D-pad up / left / down / right, 12 / 13 = left side; hat = POV1. Corrected: button 8 was listed as a separate button next to the hat. Axis DirectInput names not known. VID:PID 362C:0001 and HID name not confirmed by public documentation (originally derived from a local game configuration file); verify on a real device.

devices.name: HORI ACE COMBAT 8: Wings of Theve Flight Stick (SPF-034, PS5/PS4/PC)

identify.note: Single ambidextrous stick (2026) with Hall-effect sensors, twist, independent throttle and brake levers on the stick, High-G mode button, customisable buttons; two units can be linked for twin-stick use. HORI vendor id is 0F0D; product id and HID name not published (names here are the product name) and no button map -> controls without input. Not a HOTAS: the older two-piece PS4-144 HOTAS is hori-hotas-flight-stick.

devices.name: HORI HOTAS Flight Stick for Xbox Series X|S (MBS-015U, Xbox One / PC)

identify.note: Separate joystick and throttle joined by a modular cable, one USB device. Per the manual it works on PC only through XInput ('does not support DirectInput'): Windows shows it as an Xbox controller. Gamepad mode: left stick = pitch/roll, ladder (rudder rocker) = LB/RB, throttle = LT/RT; Flight mode (Xbox only) turns them into axes. VID 0F0D (HORI); product id not published. The older Xbox One HOTAS is hori-hotas-one.

devices.name: HORI HOTAS Flight Control System & Mount for Windows 11/10 (HPC-045U)

identify.note: PC HOTAS made with Gaijin (War Thunder): Hall-effect joystick with dual-stage trigger, twin throttle (levers lock together or split), rudder function, control panel with metal toggle switches, steel desk mount; companion app; optional XInput driver. VID 0F0D (HORI); product id, HID name and button map not published -> controls without input.

Budget stick sold by Defender (VID 11C0 = Betop in usb.ids; 5605 = variant). Mode switch NAV/BVR/VIS: the same red buttons, witch hat and pinky trigger report different numbers per mode (NAV 3-9, BVR 10-16, VIS 17-23); triggers 1/2 and the POV hat are the same in all modes. Numbers per the EDRefCard Cobra M5 map; each mode copy is listed on the same physical control. Axes X, Y, RZ twist.

devices.name: Speedlink Black Widow Force (force-feedback flight stick)

devices.name: Speedlink Black Hawk Force (dual-vibration flight stick)

names: Padix Co. Ltd. Trust GM-2600 Joystick
